_readme: TRA-4261 — the repo-resident deploy hold read by scripts/render-redeploy.mjs. See ops/README-deploy-hold.md for the shape and the rules. This file is on the TIP, so it ships with whatever ships and is discoverable by `git log ops/deploy-hold.json` and by grep — not only by whoever happened to read a ticket thread. An empty `holds` array is the cleared state; DELETING the file is also the cleared state. Every gate in render-redeploy.mjs fails CLOSED, and so does this one: an unparseable file or a hold missing a required field REFUSES, it does not degrade to allowed. TRA-4262: `emits` is a SNAPSHOT OF A MOVING TIP — this script ships the tip, never a pin, so every hold must stamp the `enumeratedTip` its `emits` was taken against (a required field), and the enumeration is RE-TAKEN at clear time by the clearer. ⛔ TRA-4224 BASELINE CORRECTION: `git log <enumeratedTip>..origin/main` is NOT the whole check — it answers 'has anything landed since I last looked', which is the narrow question. A deploy moves the box from THE LIVE DEPLOYED PIN to the tip, so the window `emits` must cover is `git log <live pin>..origin/main`, with the live pin read off `GET /api/health/options-live` (`build.commit`) at clear time. Stamp it in `enumeratedFromLivePin`. Measured on the TRA-4217 hold 2026-09-01: four consecutive re-takes all measured forward and all missed the same 22-commit tail, 13 of them shipping server bytes. Instrument fix: TRA-4268.

holds.reason: Deploying bqb1 right now RUNS THE TRA-4218 HEAL ON THREE OPEN REAL-MONEY ROWS. e1dbf341 is already an ancestor of origin/main and this script ships the TIP, not a pin (TRA-3888: a pinned --commit ages, drop it, ship the tip), so a deploy taken for any UNRELATED reason performs that migration on live money in production Tradier ***0154. The heal is not a code path that waits to be called: it runs at snapshot import, i.e. at boot, in OptionsAccount.importSnapshot (packages/server/src/options-account.ts, the TRA-4218 block). Whether that migration should run tonight is a board decision and it is NOT this gate's to make — it is the pending human_only card on TRA-4217 (`101f5a22` as of 2026-09-01T20:10Z; the previously cited `438ed4c5` EXPIRED UNANSWERED at 19:51:11Z — re-derive the live id, see clearedBy). This hold exists so that the decision is TAKEN rather than inherited by whoever deploys next.
emits: e1dbf341ae28c27159f884ffd0f21a568626f751 (TRA-4218) boots into OptionsAccount.importSnapshot and, for every open row whose exitErrorReason matches TRANSPORT_STRANDED_REASON_RE (5xx / 429 / 408 / fetch failure), DELETES closeRejectCount.
On the same rows it DELETES exitBreakerTrip where exitBreakerTrip.breaker === 'close_reject' (TRA-4225), which un-latches the close-reject breaker that is presently refusing the exits.

It then RE-ARMS through one backoff step: exitTransportFailCount = 1 and exitRetryNotBeforeMs = now + exitTransportBackoffMs(1). After that step expires the exit path is live again, so this is a change that can PLACE ORDERS, not merely a change to a counter.

Population as measured on 2026-08-31: ALL THREE open real-money OTM rows in production Tradier account ***0154, two of them under a BREACHED stop. There is no smaller blast radius available — the heal is unconditional on the rows that match.

1937a198 (TRA-4218) SHIPS SERVER BYTES AND NARROWS emits[0]: packages/server/src/options-account.ts, packages/shared/src/index.ts (plus two .test.ts fixtures). The heal described in emits[0] fired on any `closeRejectCount > 0` whose `exitErrorReason` matched TRANSPORT_STRANDED_REASON_RE. That predicate reads the LAST failure on the row, not the counter: a row holding two GENUINE broker refusals whose next attempt hit a 500 wears the transport notice (the transport branch prefixes the broker's own reason) over a refusal-built counter, and the heal would have deleted those two refusals and handed a broker that already said no twice a fresh three-attempt budget. It never trips the breaker at 2 of 3, so it appears in no close_reject_breaker census. This commit adds a second, text-independent term: the rejection branch stamps `closeRejectRefusalsOnly` on every increment, and the heal now requires its ABSENCE (= 'written by a build that could still inflate this counter with a 5xx' = legacy). STRICTLY NARROWING — it can only make the heal act on FEWER rows, never more, and it opens no order path that emits[0] did not already open. NO-OP ON THE POPULATION THIS HOLD IS ABOUT: all three open real-money rows read on bqb1 at 2026-09-01T20:06Z (pin 092d0877, startedAt 18:04:59.811Z) carry closeRejectCount 3 with NO closeRejectRefusalsOnly and NO exitTransportFailCount — those fields did not exist when they latched — so the new term admits all three unchanged and emits[0..3] still describe what a deploy does to them, exactly. 750 tests green across 29 exit/breaker/adoption files; tsc clean on shared + server.

⛔ BASELINE CORRECTION 2026-09-01T21:00Z (LeadDev, TRA-4224 monitor wake). EVERY ENUMERATION ABOVE — the 14:32Z original and all four re-takes — MEASURED FORWARD FROM A TIP. NOT ONE OF THEM ASKED WHAT THE BOX IS RUNNING. A deploy does not move this service from `enumeratedTip` to the tip; it moves it from THE LIVE PIN to the tip. bqb1 is on `092d087775dc` (pid 52, startedAt 2026-09-01T18:04:59.811Z, read off /api/health/options-live at 20:5xZ), and the first enumeration was taken against `4e0f4438` — TWENTY-TWO COMMITS LATER. So the whole list above describes the window `4e0f4438..tip`, while a deploy ships `092d0877..tip`. The 22-commit tail was never in anyone's window, and its absence read as coverage.

MEASURED: `git log 092d087775dc..4e0f4438` = 22 commits, of which 14 change `packages/**` outside tests (isServerBytePath) — 20 non-test server files, ~4,300 added lines. EXACTLY ONE of the 14, `e1dbf341` (TRA-4218), appears anywhere above; it is emits[0], and it is there because this hold was opened FOR it, not because the tail was enumerated. THE OTHER 13 SHIP TO THE BOX AND ARE DESCRIBED NOWHERE. They are named below. ⚠ THIS IS AN INVENTORY, NOT A CHARACTERISATION: each line says WHAT LANDS, at file+line-count granularity. Only the THREE commits that touch an order or an admission path are characterised, because those are the ones that could change what the box DOES. The remaining ten still owe the clearer a read — do not treat this entry as their enumeration.

ORDER PATH, UNENUMERATED: `4e0f4438` (TRA-4259) SHIPS SERVER BYTES: index.ts +45, options-account.ts +26/-2. It is the tip the 14:32Z enumeration was taken AGAINST, so it sits exactly on the boundary and fell off both sides. Direction is CONSERVATIVE — it can only refuse a close that previously submitted, never open one — but it is a real behavioural change on a real-money close path and it belongs in a blast-radius list rather than in its ticket alone.

Benign for money as shipped; NOT benign for graders (`/api/health/live-options-fee-slippage` gains an entry-site asset-class census, and `scanRun.reject('asset_class_refused')` becomes a reachable reject code). ⚠ THE ENV FLAG IS THE WHOLE SAFETY MARGIN: this deploy makes arming a one-variable act on the box, and TRA-3703 Q5 has not been answered.

The eight further commits in the window (`7465ba6d`, `07d45290`, `d9433ead`, `fcfa793d`, `4122e8e2`, `aa58a657`, `b8375385`, `cbaf5d14`) touch no server byte. 10 + 3 + `e1dbf341` = the 14; 14 + 8 = the 22.

THE RULE THIS CORRECTS, so the hole cannot be re-acquired: THE BASELINE FOR `emits` IS THE LIVE DEPLOYED PIN, NEVER THE ENUMERATOR'S STARTING TIP. `enumeratedTip` answers 'has anything landed SINCE I looked' — it was never able to answer 'does this list cover what the box GAINS', and the gate that grades it (`deployHoldStaleness`, gate −1b) compares `enumeratedTip..origin/main` only: the live pin never enters it, BY DESIGN, because gate −1 is offline and resolving the live pin needs the network. So the instrument cannot see this class and reported CURRENT/STALE truthfully while the list was structurally short by 22 commits. `enumeratedFromLivePin` below is the missing half; the instrument fix is TRA-4268.

`4dfe7486`'s own re-enumeration commit (this entry) SHIPS NO SERVER BYTE: it edits ops/deploy-hold.json only, so gate −1b will read STALE against `615aa315` for an ops-only delta. That is the mechanism working, not a new hazard.

THIS LIST GOES STALE THE NEXT TIME ANYONE PUSHES. It describes `092d087775dc..615aa315` — from the LIVE PIN, not from a tip. Before clearing, run BOTH `git log 615aa315..origin/main` (what landed since) AND `git log <live pin read off /api/health/options-live>..origin/main` (what the box actually gains), and re-enumerate — see clearedBy. render-redeploy.mjs prints only the first of those two in its refusal (TRA-4262), and only for a deploy somebody actually attempts.

holds.clearedBy: The board answering the LIVE decision card on TRA-4217 — as of 2026-09-01T20:10Z that is `101f5a22` (pending, created 19:51:43Z), NOT `438ed4c5`, which EXPIRED UNANSWERED at 19:51:11Z. ⚠️ A CARD ID IN THIS FIELD AGES THE SAME WAY `emits` DOES: TRA-4217's card has been re-posted six times (5d195de5 cancelled, ef483f54/8614034c/438ed4c5/3f453050 expired, f13de3d5 cancelled) and each re-post is a NEW id, so re-derive the pending one from `GET /api/issues/9b7d7b6a-36de-438b-83de-199bc31b87b7/interactions` rather than trusting the literal here. THE CONDITION IS THE DECISION, NOT THE ID: the board must answer the `stock` question on the pending card. Note its options MOVED — the live card's CEO recommendation is now `close_open` (hand-close all 3 at the 09-02 open), with `deploy` (e1dbf341 heals the latch at import) as the alternative; the earlier card had `deploy` as the CEO-recommended route. If the board picks a non-deploy option, this hold does NOT auto-clear — the answer must say what happens to the heal, because the heal still runs at the next boot for ANY reason. TWO ACTS, BOTH REQUIRED IN THE CLEARING COMMIT (TRA-4262 — this script ships the TIP, so an authorization enumerated in advance is an authorization for a smaller box than the one that ships): (1) RE-ENUMERATE — FROM THE LIVE PIN, NOT FROM `enumeratedTip` (BASELINE CORRECTION, TRA-4224, 2026-09-01T21:00Z; instrument fix TRA-4268). Read the running commit off `GET /api/health/options-live` (`build.commit`, beside `build.startedAt` — re-read it, never recall it) and run `git log <live pin>..origin/main` and `git diff --name-only <live pin>..origin/main`. THAT is the window a deploy ships. `git log <enumeratedTip>..origin/main` answers only 'has anything landed since the last look' — it is the narrower question, it is the one render-redeploy.mjs prints, and taking it for the whole check is exactly how 22 commits went unenumerated under four consecutive re-takes. For every commit that lands after the CURRENT enumeratedTip (never a literal SHA copied from a past re-take — that is the staleness this field keeps re-acquiring), either EXTEND emits[] with what it emits, or state in the clearing commit message that the delta touches no server byte (nothing under packages/ outside tests) and why that is safe. `packages/**` outside tests is what ships to the box; `ops/`, `scripts/`, `docs/` do not. (2) CLEAR. Delete this entry in the SAME commit as the deploy carrier, so the hold, its final enumeration and its release are one reviewable diff. On `hold`: leave the entry, re-stamp enumeratedTip/enumeratedAt to whatever you just measured against, and say on TRA-4217 what the new condition is — a hold left standing on a stale enumeration is the defect TRA-4262 filed. Do NOT clear it because it is inconvenient — --override-hold exists for the genuine emergency, records itself, and now also names the staleness it is overriding.
